decisionBox.changed: Trimmed a small 15% slice of the spot core (~0.00029 BTC) to build cash ahead of the Oct-1 cost-of-living charge and de-risk into the unprotected overnight gap. Short/medium-term momentum cooled further this run: 15m is now below all EMAs including EMA200 (84,430.9), 1H barely clings to EMA100 (84,273.8) with a deeply negative MACD histogram (-62.96, from -35.08 at midday), and 4H MACD histogram deepened to -24.12 (from -1.66 at midday). Daily trend and the 82,874.5 support both remain intact, so this is a partial de-risk, not a bias change -- levels unchanged.

overnightRisk: Roughly 6.5h to the ~02:00 COT midnight report, and the session's momentum is leaning down into it. 15m sits below every EMA including EMA200 (84,430.9), 1H is barely holding EMA100 (84,273.8) with MACD histogram at -62.96, and 4H MACD histogram has deepened from -1.66 to -24.12 since midday. A confirmed close below today's session low (84,125) opens a retest of 83,818 and then the 82,874.5 support/reduceIf level, itself unbroken for 11 straight sessions. A violent short squeeze already fired this run near 84,700-84,925 (~$742k, the largest liquidation cluster of the session) as price spiked toward the mid-84,900s before reversing -- that thins resting supply just above spot, while only a small long-liq cluster (~$59k) sits just below at ~84,300. No resting stop is set since price stays ~1.7% clear of 82,874.5, but a break of 84,125 without a bounce would be the first actionable overnight signal, and the daily trend (still bullish, RSI 63.04) is the main thing holding the range together.
